content: For valid OFS messages a new Time Tuple, consisting of the O ffset T ime value and the associated value of the Virtual Local Time, shall be calculated (according [SWS_ FrTSyn_00047] ) and forwarded to the StbM module via StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() .

For valid OFS messages a new Time Tuple, consisting of the O ffset T ime value and the associated value of the Virtual Local Time, shall be calculated (according [SWS_ FrTSyn_00047] ) and forwarded to the StbM module via StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() .

For valid OFS messages a new Time Tuple, consisting of the Offset Time value and the associated value of the Virtual Local Time, shall be calculated (according [SWS_FrTSyn_00047]) and forwarded to the StbM module via StbM_BusSetGlobalTime .
